cover.title: In Variablesland
cover.quote: — We're all mad here. I'm mad. You're mad.\n— How do you know I'm mad?\n— You must be, or you wouldn't have come here.
cover.text: Like Alice following the rabbit, this project is a journey through a world of decisions and surprises.\nI found a small golden key and opened the door without knowing what lay beyond.\nIt doesn't follow rigid conventions or pretend to be an example of anything: it's a rabbit hole to get lost in.

scope-hole.title: Down Scope-creep Hole
scope-hole.quote: Down, down, down... Would the fall never come to an end?\nI wonder how deeper I've fallen by this time.

pool-types.title: The pool of Types
pool-types.quote: But if I'm not the same, the next question is, Who in the world am I?\nAh, THAT'S the great puzzle!

ai-race.title: A long AI Tale
ai-race.quote: — Tokens! Tokens! Everybody has won, and all must have tokens.\n— But who is to give the tokens?\n— Why, SHE, of course

rabbit-grid.title: Rabbit sends in a little Grid
rabbit-grid.quote: — It was much pleasanter at home… when one wasn't always growing larger and smaller,\nand being ordered about by devices and rabbits.

error-caterpillar.title: Error from a Caterpillar
error-caterpillar.quote: — But when you have to turn into a chrysalis, and then after that into a butterfly,\nI should think you'll feel it a little queer, won't you?\n— Not a bit. Keep your temper

bootstrap-pepper.title: Bootstrap and pepper
bootstrap-pepper.quote: — Would you tell me, please, which way I should go to get in?\n— That depends a good deal on where you want to get to.\n— I don't much care where...

mad-teatime.title: A mad Teatime party
mad-teatime.quote: — If you knew Time as well as I do, you wouldn't talk about wasting it. It's Him.\nI dare say you never even spoke to Time!\n— Perhaps not, but I know I have to beat Time when I learn

queens-croquet.title: Queen's Croquet-ground
queens-croquet.quote: The Queen will be furious if she finds out.\nOff with their heads!
queens-croquet.text: La cabeza sin cuerpo introduce una idea interesante: ¿Puede existir una entidad incompleta? la autoridad de Wonderland es absurda. Empieza a perder el miedo. Un flujo constante de datos donde el tiempo parece no importar, los mensajes se cruzan y si no gestionas bien las suscripciones, terminas con un caos mental.

turtle-semantic.title: Mock Turtle's Semantic
turtle-semantic.quote: — And the moral of that is:\nTake care of the semantics and the sense will take care of itself.

lobster-quadrille.title: The Lobster Quadrille
lobster-quadrille.quote: — You first form into a line along the sea-shore— You can really have no notion how delightful it will be\nWhen they take us up and throw us, with the lobsters, out to sea!\n— It must be a very pretty dance
lobster-quadrille.text: Un baile coordinado de elementos HTML que entran y salen del DOM siguiendo un ritmo definido por tus estados de transición. En un sistema caótico, incluso las reglas más absurdas se pueden experimentar y manipular, si entiendes la lógica interna de cada elemento. seguir instrucciones perfectamente claras que no llevan a ningún resultado lógico.

who-stole.title: Who stole the tarts?
who-stole.quote: Begin at the beginning, and go on till you come to the end: then stop.\nSentence first — verdict afterwards.
who-stole.text: Intentar acabar, empezar otra vez, y nunca cacabarr

declaration.title: Sarah's Declaration
declaration.quote: — You're nothing but a pack of variables!\n— That proves his guilt\n— Stuff and nonsense!
declaration.text: Despiertas con una aplicación funcional y sólida.

end-guide.title: The End Guide
end-guide.text: A small visual guide of what's been built so far.
